sql_text: SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS total_lines FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_custkey HAVING COUNT(l_linenumber) > 50 ORDER BY total_lines DESC LIMIT 50;
SELECT o_orderkey, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderkey HAVING COUNT(l_linenumber) = 7 ORDER BY line_count DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT o_orderkey, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o_orderkey HAVING COUNT(l_linenumber) > 5 ORDER BY line_count DESC LIMIT 50;
SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, COUNT(l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderkey) t;

SELECT o_orderpriority, COUNT(*) AS multi_line_orders FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderkey, o_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(l_linenumber) > 5 GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY multi_line_orders DESC;
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) > 50000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) > 30000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) > 100000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < 200 GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) > 50000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, AVG(ps_availqty) AS avg_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING AVG(ps_availqty) > 5000 ORDER BY avg_stock DESC;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) > 50000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
SELECT s_nationkey, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_nationkey HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) > 500000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) > 50000 ORDER BY s_name;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS supply_value FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > 5000000 ORDER BY supply_value DESC;

SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name HAVING SUM(ps_availqty) BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, MAX(ps_availqty) AS max_stock FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name ORDER BY max_stock DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS regional_revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY regional_revenue DESC;

SELECT r_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS regional_revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY regional_revenue ASC;

SELECT r_name, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_order FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY avg_order DESC;

SELECT r_name, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY order_count DESC;

SELECT r_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS regional_revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY regional_revenue DESC;

SELECT r_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS regional_revenue, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY regional_revenue DESC;

SELECT r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY unique_customers DESC;

SELECT r_name, MAX(o_totalprice) AS max_order FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY max_order DESC;

SELECT r_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS regional_revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY regional_revenue DESC;

SELECT r_name, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_order, MIN(o_totalprice) AS min_order FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY avg_order DESC;

SELECT r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n_name) AS nation_count, SUM(o_totalprice) AS regional_revenue FROM region JOIN nation ON r_regionkey = n_regionkey JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY regional_revenue DESC;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY cheap_parts ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) * 0.9 GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY s_name HAVING COUNT(ps_partkey) > 50 ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_name, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_cheap_qty FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY total_cheap_qty DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_nationkey, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY s_nationkey ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT MIN(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) + 10 GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) AND ps_availqty > 1000 GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT s_name, COUNT(ps_partkey) AS cheap_parts FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey WHERE ps_supplycost < 100 GROUP BY s_name ORDER BY cheap_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s_name, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_name HAVING MIN(ps_supplycost) < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) ORDER BY min_cost ASC LIMIT 20;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY ship_year;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY total_qty DESC;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY ship_year;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY ship_year;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) >= 1993 GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY ship_year;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) <= 1997 GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY ship_year;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_year HAVING SUM(l_quantity) > 50000 ORDER BY ship_year;
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_month, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_month ORDER BY ship_month;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, MAX(l_quantity) AS max_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY ship_year;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31' GROUP BY ship_year ORDER BY total_qty ASC;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l_shipdate) AS ship_qtr, SUM(l_quantity) AS total_qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_year, ship_qtr ORDER BY ship_year, ship_qtr;
SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL;
SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL ORDER BY c_custkey;
SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_mktsegment FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL;
SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT o_custkey FROM orders);
SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL AND c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING';
SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL AND c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_order_customers FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL;
SELECT c_mktsegment, COUNT(*) AS inactive_count FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL GROUP BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY inactive_count DESC;
SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL AND c_acctbal > 0 ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC;
SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_acctbal FROM customer LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL AND c_acctbal <= 0;

SELECT n_name, COUNT(*) AS customers_without_orders FROM nation JOIN customer ON n_nationkey = c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey WHERE o_orderkey IS NULL GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY customers_without_orders DESC;
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT';
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS high_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '2-HIGH';
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS medium_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '3-MEDIUM';
SELECT o_orderpriority, SUM(o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM orders GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01';
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS urgent_count, SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT';
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH');
SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_urgent_price FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT';
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) AS urgent_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' AND o_totalprice > 100000;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_parts ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) > 10 ORDER BY distinct_parts DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_parts DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_suppliers DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c_mktsegment, AVG(dp.distinct_parts) AS avg_distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN (SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_custkey) dp ON c_custkey = dp.o_custkey GROUP BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY avg_distinct_parts DESC;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate <= DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT' GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_parts DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(*) AS total_lineitems FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY total_lineitems DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT c_custkey, c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY distinct_parts DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey;
SELECT AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01';
SELECT AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31';
SELECT AVG(l_commitdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_commit FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey;
SELECT AVG(l_receiptdate - l_shipdate) AS avg_transit_days FROM lineitem;
SELECT o_orderpriority, AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY o_orderpriority ORDER BY o_orderpriority;
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS yr, AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr;
SELECT l_shipmode, AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY l_shipmode ORDER BY avg_days_to_ship;
SELECT MAX(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS max_days_to_ship, MIN(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS min_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey;
SELECT AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT';
SELECT AVG(l_shipdate - o_orderdate) AS avg_days_to_ship FROM orders JOIN lineitem ON o_orderkey = l_orderkey WHERE l_shipdate - o_orderdate > 7;
SELECT p_type, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_type HAVING AVG(p_retailprice) > 1200 ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
SELECT p_type, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_type HAVING AVG(p_retailprice) > 1500 ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
SELECT p_type, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_type HAVING AVG(p_retailprice) < 1200 ORDER BY avg_price ASC;
SELECT p_type, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_type HAVING AVG(p_retailprice) >= 1000 ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
SELECT p_type, MIN(p_retailprice) AS min_price, MAX(p_retailprice) AS max_price, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_type ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
SELECT p_type, COUNT(*) AS part_count, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_type HAVING AVG(p_retailprice) > 1200 ORDER BY part_count DESC;
SELECT p_brand, AVG(p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part GROUP BY p_brand HAVING AVG(p_retailprice) > 1200 ORDER BY avg_price DESC;
